purpose: Introduce the outcome of a completed process.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Verb past form + 結果; noun + の結果
After thorough discussion, we postponed the trip.
As a result of practicing every day, I became able to play to the end.
formation: Verb past form + 結果; noun + の結果
restrictions: The preceding event is treated as a process that produced the result.
mistake: 結果 is the outcome, not an intention expressed by ために.
